newsitem.title: USA: Donnkenny stock hits year low after downgrades.
newsitem.headline: Donnkenny stock hits year low after downgrades.

text.p: The stock of Donnkenny Inc. tumbled to a 12-month low Monday after major Wall Street firms downgraded the women's sportswear maker.
The stock fell $2.875 to $4.1875 on Nasdaq.
Prudential Securities cut DonnKenny's stock to sell from buy and Bear Stearns downgraded it to unattractive from neutral. Analysts at the two firms declined to comment on their reports.
DonnKenny's stock has fallen in recent weeks on news the company's auditors had resigned and after it warned that its 1996 earnings will not meet analysts' expectations of $1.30 to $1.40 a share.
The New York-based company had profits of $4.6 million, or 44 cents a share, on sales of $86.6 million in the third quarter.
